tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bdud rtsi phud skong chung ba'o:1$0000250 'di yi bya thabs ni: rin po che'i snod kyi nang du: chang phud dang: phud sna tshogs la pañtsa bsre: bdud rtsi byin rlabs gzhung bzhin bya'o: 'dis ni dam tshig gi nyams chag dang: lhag ma shor ba dang: ser snas bsgribs pa thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur ro:1$0000300

ྈྈྈྈ bdud rtsi phud skong bzhugs so: oṃ: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: buddha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud gnyan gyi mchod pa bzhes: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: sgrub mchog bdag la byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: gti mug rnam par dag gyur cig: chos dbyings ye shes rtogs par shog: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang dmod mo rig sngags zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: zhe sdang rnam par dag gyur cig: me long lta bu'i ye shes rtogs par shog: hūm̐: ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: nga rgyal rnam par dag gyur cig: mnyam nyid ye shes rtogs par shog: hūm̐: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: padma gsung gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: 'dod chags rnam par dag gyur cig: so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rtogs par shog: hūm̐: ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:

phur pa phrin las lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: phrag dog rnam par dag gyur cig: bya grub ye shes rtogs par shog: hūm̐: sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad la: ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa zlog: phra men ma yi ngan sngags zlog: rmis ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog: lo skag zla skag thams cad zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i dus la babs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: thugs rje gdung 'tshob 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: dug lnga rnam par dag gyur cig: sku lnga ye shes thob par shog: hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: dus min 'chi ba brgyad rnams zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: rmis ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i dus la babs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas:

bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: byad dang rig sngags dmod mo zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: dus min 'chi ba brgyad rnams zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog rmis ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i dus la babs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phyi rim bar khyams khor yug chen po nas: dpal gyi bka' sdod lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: chang phud bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas gnyan gyis thugs dam bskang: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: byad dang rig sngags dmod pa zlog: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi: dus min 'chi ba brgyad rnams zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: rmis ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i dus la babs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: phud skong bsdus pa mnga' bdag nyang gi gter ma them med kyi chos sde las byon pa'o/// /
